searched: Searched on 2026-10-27: arXiv abstract pages and PDFs (version 1) and the arXiv API for Seed reports (Seed-Thinking-v1.5 / Seed1.5-Thinking 2504.13914, Seed1.5-VL 2505.07062, Seed-Coder 2506.03524, Seed-X 2507.13618, Seed1.8 Model Card 2603.20633, Seed2.0 Model Card 2607.00248); the Hugging Face ByteDance-Seed organisation listing (licence tags of about sixty repositories) and pinned README and LICENSE files for Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct, Seed-Coder-8B-Instruct (every revision's licence metadata compared) and Seed-X-Instruct-7B; the ByteDance-Seed/seed-oss Git repository (blob-less clone; LICENSE at commit 3dc77576); seed.bytedance.com in Chinese (home page, the Doubao-1.5-pro page, and the Alignment & Preparedness announcement of 14 October 2026). The seed.bytedance.com blog index is a JavaScript shell with no text, so other Seed blog posts (for example release posts for Seed1.5-VL, Seed1.6 or Seed2.0) were not located; no Seed2.1 document was cited although the home page lists it. No ByteDance corporate filing exists for this purpose (ByteDance is not listed), so no backer records are drafted. The Internet Archive was not consulted (refused from this environment). Coordinator: a drafted record crediting Wu Yonghui as team lead on the Seed-Thinking report was removed before merging, because the identification rests on name and timing alone.

claims.subject: bytedance-seed
claims.statement: The Seed-OSS model card (Hugging Face revision of 26 August 2025) describes the Seed Team as ByteDance's, stating that the Seed-OSS models were developed by ByteDance's Seed Team.

time.note: State shown in the model card at the cited revision; the card does not date when the team became part of ByteDance, and the existing record gives its stated founding year as 2023.

claims.qualification: The card states the possessive relation ('ByteDance's Seed Team'); it does not describe the team's internal reporting line, legal entity or headcount.

evidence.passage: Seed-OSS is a series of open-source large language models developed by ByteDance's Seed Team

claims.subject: bytedance-seed
claims.statement: A Chinese-language page on ByteDance Seed's website, dated 22 January 2025 and titled 'Doubao 1.5pro - Doubao Team', describes the Doubao-1.5-pro model as using a mixture-of-experts architecture.

time.note: Date printed on the page; the page is mutable and was read on 27 October 2026, so the date and wording as originally published are not authenticated.

claims.qualification: The page names 'Doubao Team' as its author and is hosted on seed.bytedance.com; the relation between that name and the Seed team in January 2025 is not established beyond the hosting. The page's performance and cost statements are not recorded. Doubao-1.5-pro is described, not released as weights.

claims.subject: bytedance-seed
claims.statement: ByteDance Seed's announcement of 14 October 2026 lists among the planned work of its Alignment & Preparedness department drafting model behaviour specifications and safety guidelines, building a safety evaluation system, and promoting third-party professional testing.
